s1.a: Automated Raster to Vector Map Conversion Tool
s1.q: Map Converter automatically transforms raster map images (PNG/JPG) into vector formats (DXF and PDF). The tool detects and separates three layers: water bodies, land blocks, and road networks using advanced computer vision algorithms (HSV analysis, morphological operations, skeletonization). User-friendly web interface suitable for all users. Exported DXF files are AutoCAD-compatible with auto-colored and named layers. Supports overlay preview, command line interface, and standalone executable builds.

s2.q: An automated tax code (MST) and citizen ID lookup system from masothue.com, using AI to solve captchas with 97.36% accuracy. Features user-friendly GUI, batch processing with parallel mode (5-10 workers) for 3-5x speed boost. Automatically bypasses Cloudflare, processes captchas via SVM model, exports complete business data to Excel. Ideal tool for accountants and auditors requiring fast bulk tax information lookups.
